name: Helsinki Deblur Challenge 2021 (HDC2021) photographic dataset
description: The photographic dataset collected for the Helsinki Deblur Challenge 2021 (HDC2021) contains pairs of images taken by two identical cameras of the same target but with different conditions. One camera is always in focus and produces sharp and low-noise images the other camera produces blurred and noisy images as it is gradually more and more out of focus and has a higher ISO setting. Even though the dataset was designed and captured with the HDC2021 in mind it can be used for any testing and benchmarking of image deblurring algorithms. The data is available here: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.477228
reputation: Well-regarded in the image deblurring community as the photographic dataset for the Helsinki Deblur Challenge (HDC2021) and cited in subsequent deblurring work.
notes: Paired real-image dataset with realistic blur and noise; relatively small and domain-specific (non-LLM); potential for overfitting to the capture setup; evaluation should consider perceptual metrics in addition to PSNR/SSIM.
